SELECT 'TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.'+TABLE_NAME+'; GO' FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA LIKE '%BUSC%'
AND TABLE_NAME  LIKE 'CRM%'
AND TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%_BU_%'
AND TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%_DUP_%'
AND TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%_DELTA%' 
AND TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%TEST%'
AND TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%BACKUP%'
AND TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%2024%'
AND TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%2023%'
AND TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%_CM%'
AND TABLE_NAME NOT LIKE '%_TEMP%'
